verification.sampleStatic: Rendered MV Sample Maps 002/015/018 with existing client Tilemap renderer; inspected the full images and RTP sheets. This verifies composition only.
verification.newMapStatic: Inspected all three full-map images in engine/.artifacts/3d-demos/authored-2d after rendering temporary map copies with enable(false); original maps remain enable(true). Checked whole table/bookcase footprints, corridor openings, water boundaries and event placement. Preview renderer reported zero missing assets, errors and failed requests.
verification.data: Six-plane lengths, event IDs/coordinates and all nine transfer destinations checked. Original MapInfos 001–048 and Tilesets 001–040 are JSON-equal to HEAD. Existing unrelated project missing characters: 4scientist, DF_Actor.

runtime3d.renderer: Bundled original MV3D 0.9.2.8 in the replacement client WebGL host
runtime3d.reviewed: Actually opened all four 816x624 captures. Slopes now meet both platforms, fence posts stand above terrain, indoor gallery remains visible without a foreground dividing wall, warm/cool lights illuminate separate bays, and water/fences/transparent ice are visible. First-person camera at (7,10), height 1.3, pitch105, distance0 confirms that the ceiling underside is visible from inside while its top does not obscure the normal overhead view.
corrections: MV3D adds slopeHeight to height: region62 changed from height(1) to height(0), region63 from height(2) to height(1).
Removed the southern central indoor wall that obscured the shared gallery.
Raised ground beneath the terrace fences to prevent buried fence posts.
Separate flashlight on/off events avoid persisted self-switch state conflicting with a recreated render host.
runtime3d.slopeSampling: Original mv3d.getWalkHeight: south slope (x9, y14→12) = 0,.01,.25,.5,.75,.99,1; north slope (x18, y8→6) = 1,1.01,1.25,1.5,1.75,1.99,2. All 14 samples passed tolerance 0.001.
runtime3d.interactionReachability: Replacement World.canMove BFS with real event collisions reaches an adjacent interaction cell for all 19 guide, display, light-control and exit events across the three maps.
runtime3d.remaining: Native MV3D player collision/physics is not supplied by these map checks. Root integration verification covers avatar, camera rotation, plugin commands and return to 2D; complete animated-water frame parity is not asserted by the still captures.
